aiResearchSummary.text: Apptimize is researching run-time application modification, segmented customization, and user interface modification and usage tracking. Their work includes enabling applications to redirect operating system calls through a call handler and update module, providing different user experiences to groups of users via manifests from an optimization platform, and tracking events in user interfaces by associating event indicators with view selectors. These areas reflect a focus on dynamic app iteration and user experience optimization.
